lead: Yuvraj Singh is best known as an Indian cricketer, born on 12 December 1981 in Chandigarh.
As of 2026, he is 44 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Yorkshire County Cricket Club and has been recognised with Arjuna Award and Padma Shri in sports.
This profile collects the Yuvraj facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Yuvraj Singh — Career and Professional Work
paras: Yuvraj Singh works primarily as a cricketer.

On the team sheet, Yuvraj has been associated with India national cricket team (from 2003 to 2012), Yorkshire County Cricket Club (from 2003 to 2003), Punjab Kings (from 2008 to 2010), Punjab Kings (from 2018), Pune Warriors India (from 2011 to 2013), Royal Challengers Bengaluru (from 2014 to 2014), Delhi Capitals (from 2015 to 2015) and Sunrisers Hyderabad (from 2016 to 2017).
